sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Headless Hessian's Amulet was abandoned on an old battlefield near the town of [[Sleepy Hollow]]. It was found by [[Geoffrey Crayon]], an old man with no knowledge of the [[Seeker]] world, who invoked it and let it run loose in the hopes of scaring off the builders and buyers who wanted to turn the battlefield into houses. Geoffrey was unable to properly control it however, and the Titan began to attack innocent bystanders at night, leading to reports of a headless horseman terrorising the town. 

Both the [[Huntik Foundation]] and [[the Organization]] came to the town to investigate. Headless Hessian fought with [[Ford|Ford's]] [[Belgrieve]]. It then attacked [[Lok Lambert]] and defeated his [[Freelancer]]. Lok and [[Sophie]] managed to convince Geoffrey to stop using the Titan and help them stop the Organization. By leaving Headless Hessian's sword for [[Gregor]] to use and Lok dropping the Titans' helmet on his head, they succesfully framed him for the attacks, leaving him to be arrested by the town's police. Headless Hessian then saved Lok from Ford and his [[Frostanna]]. Geoffrey then gave Headless Hessian's Amulet to Dante, confident that he would find a better use for the Titan. {{Source|The Headless Horseman}}

full_text:
Headless Hessian is a caped Draco-Titan horseman who wields a large curved sword. He bears golden armor as well as a fake, detachable pumpkin-like head which he hurls at his enemies.

== History ==
Headless Hessian's Amulet was abandoned on an old battlefield near the town of Sleepy Hollow. It was found by Geoffrey Crayon, an old man with no knowledge of the Seeker world, who invoked it and let it run loose in the hopes of scaring off the builders and buyers who wanted to turn the battlefield into houses. Geoffrey was unable to properly control it however, and the Titan began to attack innocent bystanders at night, leading to reports of a headless horseman terrorising the town. 

Both the Huntik Foundation and the Organization came to the town to investigate. Headless Hessian fought with Ford's Belgrieve. It then attacked Lok Lambert and defeated his Freelancer. Lok and Sophie managed to convince Geoffrey to stop using the Titan and help them stop the Organization. By leaving Headless Hessian's sword for Gregor to use and Lok dropping the Titans' helmet on his head, they succesfully framed him for the attacks, leaving him to be arrested by the town's police. Headless Hessian then saved Lok from Ford and his Frostanna. Geoffrey then gave Headless Hessian's Amulet to Dante, confident that he would find a better use for the Titan. [The Headless Horseman]

== Abilities ==
Headless Hessian is able to remove his head and throw at his enemies to frighten them. The head can be used as a fire bomb, exploding into an engulfing ball of flames on impact with a target or surface. A master of riding, Headless Hessian is extremely fast while he is undeniably talented at his swordsman abilities. He will often ride around his target and strike them from behind when they least expect it. [The Headless Horseman]
